documents.title: PolicyStreet integration engineering
documents.text: At PolicyStreet, Mohd worked as Senior Full Stack Developer and later Director, Engineering during 2019–2021. He built backend and frontend rate fetching and normalization, integrating quotation and policy issuance across motor, medical, group medical and fire insurance for internal and partner workflows. He designed an event-driven quotation architecture using Node.js and introduced quotation caching and pre-warmed data to reduce repeated processing and support faster quotations, including potential renewals for existing customers. Quotations expire after seven days. Customer-information changes affecting quotation terms require quotation revision; caching and pre-warming do not override validity requirements. No cache product, broker, cache TTL implementation, automatic invalidation, exact latency or measured financial/conversion benefit is established.

documents.title: Education platform modernisation
documents.text: The education-platform case describes full-stack development and technical direction as Principal Full Stack Engineer at Centre for Content Creation. Mohd engaged stakeholders to understand operational processes, identify requirements and design suitable workflows across established and modernized education and administrative systems. High-level examples include online class activity tracking and HRMS document-expiration tracking. Workflows were shaped around actual stakeholder responsibilities while supporting continued operation, maintainability and modernization of existing systems. Internal product identities and detailed implementation remain private. The public evidence does not establish notification mechanisms, attendance implementation, efficiency metrics or replacement of every legacy process. These education-sector HRMS examples are not attributed to WenSymes or the earlier collaborative HR engagement.

documents.title: WenSymes full-stack work
documents.text: The WenSymes engagement describes Principal Full Stack Developer work on internal HR and administration tools using full-stack web development, Google Cloud and Microsoft 365. Professional collaboration began in March 2025 and continues occasionally; this is not a claim of uninterrupted permanent employment. The design prioritized flexibility for evolving employee roles and responsibilities as organizational headcount and operational needs changed. Clear responsibilities and appropriate access to HR information are engineering considerations. Planning considered data consistency, access control and uptime. The evidence supports an adaptable design priority, not proof of a fully configurable RBAC engine, particular permission mechanism, confidential HR rule or quantified result. This engagement is distinct from the earlier collaborative Centre for Content Creation HR work in 2016–2017 and from education-platform HRMS document-expiration workflows.

documents.title: Rental operations domain modelling
documents.text: The MegaInfinite rental operations project was designed and implemented by Mohd as a freelance Principal Full Stack Solution Developer during 2018–2020. The mobile-friendly, web-based system supported connected property, tenant and contract records, payments, renewals, cancellations and property-level income, expenses and profit/loss reporting across more than 20 properties. Realtors could access rental records, support contract renewals, send contract PDFs directly from their phones and review rental and financial reports remotely. This describes internet-connected access through compatible mobile and desktop browsers. No native app, offline functionality, digital signature, automated delivery mechanism, user count, productivity metric or measured revenue improvement is established.
